paths: All dataset/features/checkpoint/output/local_dir/model/review paths explicit CLI arguments; raw text/media stay under --local-dir

sampling.algorithm: Lexicographic minimum selected Dialogue count, selected true class count, selected(class,clean correctness,confidence bin) count, seeded tie rank

text_review.format: Local JSONL one row per sample x neutral_a/neutral_b/paraphrase_a/paraphrase_b; all480 rows per dataset must remain
text_review.strict_main_requires: PASS + attributed reviewer/method/reason + token/content QC + all planned K
qc: changed text AND changed token IDs
different token IDs within each 2-variant family
neutral exact original text prefix and no original token deletion

audio_review.format: Local audio_label_review.csv with clean/processed paths and original text for listening; PENDING default
audio_review.unconfirmed_audio_scope: Separate AUDIO_SIGNAL_QC_ONLY_NOT_LABEL_CONFIRMED exploration; clean correctness only; no perturbed accuracy/calibration/C-to-W/W-to-C

audio_dsp.pitch: FFmpeg asetrate(round(16000*2^(semitones/12))), aresample16000, atempo reciprocal actual ratio; exact sample count restore, RMS restore then peak attenuation if needed
audio_dsp.timbre: Whole-utterance rFFT gain clip(slope*log2(max(freq,80)/1000),-cap,+cap) dB, inverse FFT and RMS restore

inference.encoder_state_verification: All encoder parameters and buffers compared bitwise in producer; complete before/after state hashes bound in cache. CMERC consumer verifies provenance and its own state unchanged.

statistics.shared_draws: Full selected-cohort Dialogue universe, common seed(dataset,confidence bin) across types/modalities/metrics/scopes
statistics.within_Dialogue_confidence: Only cells with both clean-correct and clean-error; fixed equal cell weights; shared Dialogue bootstrap; support fractions/effective cells/NA reported

runtime_split.reason: Pinned encoder runtime lacks torch_geometric; CMERC runtime has a different transformers version. Encoder generation and CMERC inference are explicit independent processes.

precomputed_feature_schema.variant_record: sample_id,dialogue_id,utterance_index,modality,perturbation_type,variant_id,planned_k,status,original_feature_sha256,QC/review fields; EXTRACTED adds CPU FP32 feature,target_feature_sha256; text also actual_token_ids + array_hash(int64 IDs), audio transformation/source/waveform hashes
precomputed_feature_schema.sidecar: CACHE.manifest.json with format/mode/dataset/status, complete metadata exactly equal to bundle, cache_sha256
precomputed_feature_schema.input_sha256: Absolute resolved file paths and actual bytes hashes: dataset, feature caches, frozen CMERC checkpoint, protocol, encoder/producer/consumer source, selected encoder weights/tokenizer, raw media/review/variant assets
precomputed_feature_schema.validation: Strict unknown modality/status/family/shape/token rejection; same source files, matching before/after encoder states; target/clean-control identity hashes; full planned variant matrix preserved

encoder_producer_cli: TEXT_repro/bin/python scripts/extract_pilot_features.py --mode pilot --dataset DS --dataset-dir DATA --text-features TEXT.pt --audio-features AUDIO.pt --checkpoint best.pt --text-model TEXT_MODEL --output CACHE.pt --local-dir LOCAL_MEDIA --pilot-output SELECT_DIR --baseline-lock LOCK.json --text-review REVIEW.jsonl --audio-review REVIEW.csv --device cuda:0

io_only_amendment.physical_LF_JSONL_boundaries: Unicode U+0085/U+2028/U+2029 inside raw strings are preserved exactly; no source text changed
io_only_amendment.completion_provenance: Return actual completion.json path/hash; former variable shadowing corrected
